entry.title: Houston Astros staff and front office: Astros hire longtime Cardinals exec Matt Bayer as assistant GM - www.nytimes.com/athletic/779...
Nick Fortes: The Red Sox release on trading for Nick Fortes and DFA'ing Connor Wong mentions this about Wong ... ... "he was acquired by Boston in a five-player trade on February 10, 2020."

Vladimir Guerrero: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. told media in the Dominican Republic that, when he was traded (in LIDOM) to Tigres del Licey yesterday, his daughter cried because she thought that it was from the #BlueJays He says he wants to play for Dominican fans who can’t see him play in-person in MLB

Around the market: New: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. wants to play winter ball with Tigres del Licey “Today, one of my dreams is coming true.” Now, he’s working on getting approval from the #BlueJays. Full story with comments from Guerrero today: www.mlb.com/bluejays/new...
Baltimore Orioles staff and front office: nypost.com/2026/11/18/s... Former Orioles manager Brandon Hyde has emerged as a candidate to be the Yankees bench coach.

Dominic Fletcher: According to a source, the #reds signed OF Dominic Fletcher to a Minor League contract with an invite to big league Spring Training. Fletcher, formerly of the White Sox and Diamondbacks, finished 2026 with Triple-A Louisville when he signed in September after being released by the Pirates org.
Free agency: I picked three free agents I'd invest in and three I would avoid. My whole avoid list and my top invest choice last winter worked out quite well! www.espn.com/mlb/story/_/...

Omar Cruz: Nats have signed LHP Omar Cruz and INF Carlos Mendoza to minor-league contracts with spring training invites. Cruz pitched in Padres system last 3 years, had 14.1K/9 IP this season at AA/AAA. Mendoza is left-handed utilityman who had .727 OPS with Blue Jays' AAA team this year.

Connor Wong: The Red Sox announced that they designated Connor Wong for assignment. That clears a 40-man roster spot for Nick Fortes, the new backup catcher, whose trade from the Rays also is now official.
Jace Jung: The Tigers have traded INF Jace Jung to the Los Angeles Angels for a cash consideration.
Josiah Gray: The Nationals’ decision to DFA Josiah Gray was a tough pill to swallow, but it was a reminder this front office isn’t beholden to players it inherited. natsjournal.com/p/despite-in...
Boston Red Sox offseason notes: Jake Bauers will have No. 18 with the Red Sox. Most recently worn with distinction by Kyle Schwarber (2021), Mitch Moreland (2017-20), and Shane Victorino (2013-15).

The trade market: Of the four prospects added, three were players acquired in trades: - Zazueta from NYY in the Caleb Ferguson deal - Ferris from CHC in the Michael Busch deal - Serwinowski from CIN in a three-teamer The fourth, Luke Fox, was taken in the 17th round of the draft.

Jake Bauers: While it seemed like an odd fit initially, Craig Breslow said the Red Sox had targeted Jake Bauers as early as June as a player who’d fit their roster. He called Bauers’ agent as soon as free agency opened and officially had Bauers signed 15 days later www.nytimes.com/athletic/779...

San Francisco Giants offseason notes: The Giants added LHP Henry Lalane, RHP Marty Gair and RHP Josh Bostick to their 40-man roster to protect them from the Rule 5 Draft. INF Christian Koss and RHP Rowan Wick were DFA'd, leaving the Giants with 40 players on their 40-man roster.

Los Angeles Dodgers offseason notes: The Dodgers added Christian Zazueta, Jackson Ferris, Adam Serwinowski and Luke Fox to their 40-man roster to protect them from the Rule 5 Draft (if there is one). To clear spots, they DFA'd Jake Cousins and Christian Cairo.
Detroit Tigers offseason notes: Tigers add Emilio Pagan, Max Anderson, Josue Briceno and Peyton Graham to 40-man roster. Jace Jung, Jake Miller, Trey Sweeney and Matt Vierling have been DFAd
St. Louis Cardinals offseason notes: Cardinals selected Jesús Báez and Jacob Odle. Max Rajcic DFA. 40-man goes full.
Cleveland Guardians offseason notes: Guardians 40-man moves: -Selected right-hander Justin Campbell and catcher Kody Huff from Columbus -Selected outfielder Jaison Chourio from Akron
New York Mets offseason notes: Mets add Jefferson Rojas to the major league roster. Dylan Ross designated for assignment, Chayce McDermott agrees to a major league deal.
Jackson Nezuh: The Astros added pitcher Jackson Nezuh to their 40-man roster, protecting him from the Rule 5 draft. Joey Loperfido cleared outright waivers and will go to Triple-A Sugar Land.

Emilio Pagán: "We have to be open-minded. We have to look to add innings in a number of different ways. Everything is on the table for us right now.” --Scott Harris after officially announcing the signing of reliever Emilio Pagan
Qualifying offers: Rogers declines $23.15 million qualifying offer from Orioles #Orioles

Labor and the CBA: Among the prospects the Nationals did not protect from the Rule 5 Draft (which may not happen anyway because of the lockout): C Maxwell Romero Jr., INF Cayden Wallace, OF Elijah Green, OF Cristhian Vaquero, OF Yeremy Cabrera.

Washington Nationals offseason notes: Nats have added Jarlin Susana, Travis Sykora and Alejandro Rosario to the 40-man roster, also claiming LHP Philip Abner off waivers from O’s. To clear space for them, they DFA’d Josiah Gray, Braxton Roxby, Gus Varland and Carson Palmquist.
Sawyer Gipson-Long: Pitchers Sawyer Gipson-Long and Bailey Horn have signed back with the Tigers on minor league deals.

Joey Loperfido: The Astros placed outfielder Joey Loperfido on outright waivers, multiple sources tell @theathletic.com. Loperfido had offseason surgery on his right hip and, according to the Astros, wasn't expected to be ready for the beginning of spring training.

Dustin May: The Dodgers traded Dustin May to the Red Sox at the 2025 trade deadline rather than put him in the bullpen. He is 8-13, 4.81 in 37 games/36 starts with three teams since. May agreed to a three-year/$52.5 million deal with the White Sox today. Get your kid pitching lessons.
Rece Hinds: Orioles release Rece Hinds, announce additional stadium improvements #Orioles

Cincinnati Reds offseason notes: The deadline to protect players ahead of the Rule 5 Draft is today at 6 pm ET. Among those eligible for the draft if not protected are #reds top 30 prospects Cam Collier, Jay Allen II, Carter Graham and Carlos Sanchez.

Tarik Skubal: The Mets indeed met with Tarik Skubal yesterday, according to multiple people with knowledge of the meeting. Cohen, Stearns among those involved. Skubal, of course, has more meetings to come this week. @JonHeyman first reported.

Jacob Young: Paul Toboni first noticed Jacob Young in 2021, when he admittedly was scouting some far-more-touted prospects at the University of Florida. Five years later, they shared a dais to discuss Young’s first MLB contract extension. natsjournal.com/p/with-exten...
Ketel Marte: Orioles have reported interest in Arizona’s Ketel Marte #Orioles
Ryan Walker: The Giants traded RHP Ryan Walker to the Brewers in exchange for Minor League RHPs Blake Holub and Gavin Perry.

Nolan Gorman: A week from today, MLB's non-tender deadline will arrive, and it seems much more likely than not that it will spell the end of Nolan Gorman's tenure in St. Louis. Is that the right decision? I took a swing at it: words-about-birds.beehiiv.com/p/with-a-loo...

Elly De La Cruz: Speculation about a potential Elly De La Cruz trade from the #reds began last month. There are pros and cons to moving him and keeping him. Here’s a look at the situation. www.mlb.com/news/elly-de...
Yordan Álvarez: Astros designated hitter Yordan Alvarez is the American League MVP. He is the first full-time designated hitter to ever win AL MVP and the third MVP in Astros franchise history.
San Francisco Giants staff and front office: The Giants have officially named James Rowson their new offensive coordinator. Rowson spent the last three seasons as the Yankees' lead hitting coach.

William Contreras: The No. 1 question Matt Arnold was asked at the GM Meetings this week: "Are you going to trade William Contreras?" You know he's not going to answer directly, so have fun parsing what he *did* say: www.mlb.com/brewers/news...
Evan Phillips: Free agent reliever Evan Phillips and Braves agree on $35M, 3-year deal @ByRobertMurray 1st

Triston Casas: Per Craig Breslow, Triston Casas is traveling to the DR today to join Licey. He'll get a few days of workouts before his first game. Casas played 3 games for Licey in the 2022-23 offseason, so the surroundings are familiar to him.
Alec Bohm: Yankees interested in Alec Bohm to fix major issue after season of turmoil nypost.com/2026/11/11/s...
Jonathan Loáisiga: Yankees, Mets and Blue Jays are among many teams in on ex-Yankee reliever Jonathan Loaisiga, who had a big year in Arizona (2.42 ERA, 1.03 WHIP)

Alex Vesia: What I’m hearing about the Dodgers in the relief and infield markets, including an extremely robust market for Alex Vesia as rival clubs scramble for left-handed relief pitching: www.nytimes.com/athletic/777...

Tampa Bay Rays offseason notes: Notes from GM Meetings with Will Sammon: — Alec Bohm/NY teams — Rays trade possibilities — Randal Grichuk — Teruaki Sato/Rangers — Jarren Duran www.nytimes.com/athletic/777...

Los Angeles Dodgers staff and front office: New Dodgers hitting coach Pedro Guerrero spoke to The Athletic about his hire and fit alongside Robert Van Scoyoc. Some of what he hopes to bring, free and unlocked: www.nytimes.com/athletic/777...
Baltimore Orioles offseason notes: Boras thinks Orioles will continue to be aggressive in pursuing free agents #Orioles
Cincinnati Reds staff and front office: The #Reds have hired former Astros and Tigers coach Anthony Iapoce to be their new assistant hitting coach.

Boston Red Sox staff and front office: The worst-kept secret at the GM Meetings is that the Red Sox are shopping Jaren Duran (a year too late, but nonetheless). Sox have also inquired about free agent Seiya Suzuki to add to a lineup that finished 12th in the AL in home runs last season

Darwinzon Hernández: Darwinzon Hernández, a lefty reliever for the Red Sox from 2019-22, pitched for the past 4 seasons for the Fukuoka Softbank Hawks and is negotiating to return to MLB. The Mets are among the teams that have checked in. Last year: 1.41 ERA/55 Ks in 44.2IP
